snippet.title: Ice Cream Simulator: Prologue - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Ice Cream Simulator: Prologue is here! 🍧

Serve customers, set your prices, and manage your own shop in this limited-access prologue. Get a taste of what the full game has to offer and start building your ice cream empire today! 💰🏬

✨ Play now and wishlist the game so you don’t miss the full release!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4554740/Ice_Cream_Simulator__Prologue
